nc.description: A mechanical lever with a scalloped head is positioned directly above a glowing white sphere resting inside a cylindrical container.
A light grey, stylized 3D model of a mechanical component featuring a sloped base and faceted knobs is displayed against a white background.
A faceted grey arm is secured within a hinged rectangular bracket on a smooth grey base.

A static, abstract grey and white geometric structure composed of interlocking smooth shapes features a segmented rod extending to the left and a metallic sphere resting inside a lower rectangular compartment.
A central white faceted polyhedron is surrounded by a symmetrical, radial arrangement of various grey mechanical components on a light background.

vc.description: A pair of pliers is gripping the cap of a translucent bottle.
A light grey, articulated mechanical assembly is shown with a threaded component separating from it in mid-air against a white background.
A metal C-clamp is attached to a grey object with a handle.
A grey, sculpted model of a complex mechanical handle featuring dials, finger grips, and a spiraled gear shaft rests on a white background.
A central grey mechanical assembly is surrounded by various gears and parts arranged in a radial pattern on a white surface.
